project_info.theme: Store update sportswear new arrival display
project_info.color_palette: White, black, light gray, beige, muted blue

main_subject.detail: A front-facing in-store merchandising display table and rack setup featuring white and black sportswear, a soccer-themed arrangement, and a vertical BADASS poster in the center, presented like a retail floor update announcement.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic retail merchandising documentation, clean store display photography, brand update social post

items: Center: a black display table with folded garments, cups, a football, and a gold trophy.
Left and Right: freestanding racks with polos, shorts, and sleeveless tops in white, black, and taupe.
Center Back: a vertical BADASS sports poster featuring a male athlete.
Below Main Title: rounded white badge with black outline containing 'NEW ARRIVAL'.
Background: clean bright retail interior with pale floor and minimal store walls.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even store illumination, clean product visibility, polished retail atmosphere, neutral documentary clarity

assets.name: full in-store sportswear display
assets.usage: Use to preserve rack positions, center table arrangement, and overall store layout.

assets.name: sportswear assortment
assets.usage: Maintain the mix of white, black, and taupe polos, shorts, and sleeveless items.

assets.name: STORE UPDATE / NEW ARRIVAL typography
assets.usage: Preserve exact wording and bottom-centered title layout.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image so the store arrangement and title placement remain close to the original.
Keep the visible text exactly as 'STORE UPDATE' and 'NEW ARRIVAL'.
Maintain a retail-documentation feel rather than stylized fashion editorial lighting.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square retail update poster for a sportswear new arrival display. Show a bright in-store merchandising setup with left and right garment racks and a central black display table. Arrange white, black, and taupe sportswear pieces, include a vertical athlete poster in the back center, a football, a gold trophy, cups, and folded garments on the table. Add huge blue text 'STORE UPDATE' across the bottom and a rounded white badge below it reading 'NEW ARRIVAL'. Technical style: photorealistic retail merchandising poster, bright showroom lighting, clean store documentation look, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, empty store, blurry products, messy layout, distorted garments, low resolution, incorrect text, harsh color cast, cluttered background, watermark, signature
